newsitem.title: USA: Gloria Estefan gives $250,000 to paralysis project.
newsitem.headline: Gloria Estefan gives $250,000 to paralysis project.

text.p: Latin pop star Gloria Estefan, who broke her back in a near-fatal car crash in 1990, on Monday presented $250,000 to the Miami Project to Cure Paralysis.
The gift will go towards a new building for the project on the University of Miami campus that will be dedicated to spinal cord injury research.
A bus crash in March 1990 left Estefan, 39, with a traumatized spinal cord but she resumed her career after sugery and months of therapy.

"Gloria's brush with paralysis left her with a very personal understanding of the challenges faced on a daily basis by millions around the world," said the project's president, Dr. Barth Green, accepting the gift from the singer at a presenation ceremony.
